steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Sum. Each month is added once to the year-to-date figure.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Month missing from the year-to-date sum
Year-to-date differs from the sum of months

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 2 findings (1 medium, 1 low).
[medium] month-04.csv:12  Month missing from the year-to-date sum.
       Fix: Add the month's records.
[low] month-06.csv:19  Year-to-date differs from the sum of months.
       Fix: Recompute from the monthly rows.
Not checked: Results after the report date.
pros: Flags a month missing, a measure with no monthly result, and a year-to-date figure that differs from the sum of its months by more than rounding.
cons: Not checked: Results after the report date.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-devops-ytd-delivery-report skill on the records for this review.
